root_cause.classification: cloud-worker package installation exceeded a source-enforced child-process timeout; not a product/API/V3 runtime failure

source_locations.detail: runChecked supplies a 300000 ms default child timeout
systemDependencyInstallPolicy overrides the dnf timeout with fixed 1200000 ms
installDependencies passes the fixed timeout to /usr/bin/dnf
npm test invokes prepareRuntime in Flow because PIPELINE_ID is set

negative_scope: API V3 context 503 is not implicated by this build failure

minimal_source_recommendation_not_applie.why_not_config: the terminal error is emitted by the source-level child_process.spawnSync invocation; the final Flow YAML does not add that 1200000 ms dnf cap
minimal_source_recommendation_not_applie.change: remove the fixed 1200000 ms DNF/YUM cap from systemDependencyInstallPolicy, and invoke that manager with Node timeout 0 (unbounded) so runChecked default cannot reintroduce a cap; retain signed package validation, fixed package allowlist, RPM probe, actual network transport timeouts, and Flow job ownership.
minimal_source_recommendation_not_applie.test_delta: replace the current bootstrap test assertion for { timeout: 1200000 } with an assertion that the DNF/YUM call receives { timeout: 0 }; keep tests for missing-only packages, RPM-probe failures, signature options, and non-DNF command behavior.
minimal_source_recommendation_not_applie.release_impact: this is a web source/test change and requires a new exact source commit and new same-Run Flow release; package.json version need not be changed solely for this CI-runtime correction.
